text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Actually, I just ran into the Oil Baron earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what in the world T.M. Opera O was going on about
out of nowhere... but since it's just her usual self, I asked for more details.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that oil baron was quite a handful.
To think he tried to scout me for his home country!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it seems my glory has reached him
even across the vast ocean."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... They even promised me a lavish life
if I ran in their country.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I turned them down!
It is not a life of luxury that I desire.
—I wish to bring happiness to the world with my beauty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The whole thing sounded suspiciously like a scam, but since she turned it down, there shouldn't be any issue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that relief was short-lived,
for a few days later—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're... Oil Baron-kun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...appeared. According to T.M. Opera O,
the person standing before us, flanked by bodyguards,
is supposedly an 'oil baron.'"

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Opera! I shall not give up!
Your noble grace can truly shine only when running in our homeland!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oil Baron-kun... I cannot do that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My brilliance remains unchanged wherever I am!
You know that deep down in your heart as well...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even so! If you still insist on scouting me, the "Supreme Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Let us duel, Mr. Oil Baron!
Allow me to remind you of the very core
of my exquisite beauty...!"

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Ho, a challenge, you say... Very well!
If you lose, you're coming to my country!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O readily agreed to an outrageous request.
I really want to help her win, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That said, I won't ask you to race.
A match that is unfair to either party holds no beauty."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-kun,
come now, brainstorm a splendid idea for me!”
choice_data_list: ...How about settling it with a racing game?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! Then let us go!
Are you prepared, my oil baron friend!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: Ah, by all means!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a duel between the oil baron
and T.M. Opera O began at the arcade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With surprisingly practiced technique,
the oil baron went on the offensive right from the start,
radiating the composure of someone certain of victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, just before the finish line—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That was a fine race, Oil Baron-kun.

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... That technique you pulled out at the very end...!
Were you going easy on me until now?!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Insulting me by thinking you can
easily overtake me whenever you want...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That is not true!! Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: Then why?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Oil Baron-kun. I shine eternally.
Yet at times, there may be spectators
blinded by such brilliance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I held back my strength, and at the very, very end,
I let its brilliance dance like a rose swaying in the wind.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Upon the limited stage of the spotlight!
So that my beloved people can burn the moment of my victory into their eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... Playing to the crowd...?!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
However, only my bodyguards were around.
Could it be she even considered them spectators...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Small numbers are no excuse for cutting corners.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My beauty constantly brings joy to the people.
That is what it means to be a ruler... an "Overlord."

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
...*sob*, uuu... *hic*.
Uuuu... *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: "...You truly are beautiful, Opera O, simply magnificent. I remember it all now—the day I fell in love with you through the screen..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My dear Oil Baron. Even in a distant foreign land,
I promise to deliver my light to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone could even interject a witty comeback into their conversation,
the match was already decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, the news was broadcasting headlines reading, "Oil Tycoon's Incognito Journey"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: A photo, you say...? Indeed, a king is always in the position to be watched by others!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! Then let us begin!
Are you prepared, my oil baron friend!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: Ah, by all means!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To keep things fair, the photos were taken
using a phone's self-timer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The oil baron was always seated somewhere.
Though he barely moved at all, it was an imposing,
majestic posture.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, her opponent, T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The mermaids forget their songs
and weep at my sheer beauty...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The ringing cowbells
are applause for my brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "The birds floating upon the lake sing in praise of my very existence...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O continued to take photos
with dynamic, sweeping poses.
Always keeping "someone" in mind with every pose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The photoshoot finished,
and everyone checked the photos they took.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: ...It's my loss, Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oil Baron-kun...

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
You think of others, bringing a brilliant light
even to the hearts of those watching...!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Whether in photos or videos, I can truly feel your life force!
This is... this is...!

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: It's the exact same thrill I felt the very first time I saw you on that monitor...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...It's alright, you don't need to say another word.
As long as you understand, that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Opera O...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll send today's photos to your email.
I can't let a fan who came all the way from
a distant foreign land go home empty-handed, after all."

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Oil Baron
text_block_list.text:
Y-You even accounted for a souvenir
for me during this match...?! 
Ah... you truly are a "Supreme Overlord"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone could even interject a witty comeback into their conversation,
the match was already decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, the news was broadcasting headlines reading, "Oil Tycoon's Incognito Journey"...
